title: Transition of the encoded simulator
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $q$ be a state of its encoded simulator. Given an optional Boolean input symbol and the symbols scanned on its $k+3$ work tapes, the definition assigns the simulator’s one-step action, including its tape movements and writes, output, and successor state or halting behavior.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
The input symbol is either absent or Boolean
